extra.final_summary:
Average body mass by sex (54 penguins used): female ≈ 3,735 g, male ≈ 4,571 g.

Data problems found and fixed:
- body_mass_g was stored as text with one value written as "3,800" (row 52); converted the column to numbers (no values lost).
- Three rows (0, 17, 34) had body_mass_g in the millions (3,650,000 / 3,500,000 / 6,000,000), far outside the rules-file range of 2500–6500 g — apparently milligram values. An in-place rescale was not possible, so these rows were excluded from the analysis (approved).
- sex labels were clean (male/female only, no variants), and there were no duplicate rows.

Caveat: the averages exclude the 3 rows with unit errors; if those values are actually milligrams, their true gram values (3650, 3500, 6000) would slightly change the means, but I did not guess the correction.
